lines.text: The root is Pend! Pension, append.
Did you know? Pend is Latin for hang.
Pension: a payment, once weighed out.
Quick quiz! Which means toward plus hang?

words.ex: My grandfather lives on a small pension.
A list of references is appended to the report.
